content.comment_body: Hello, I am interested in knowing whether it's possible to remotely adjust a set value, such as changing the room temperature from 30°C to 25°C and then to 22°C, using the arrow keys on the TD display. Is this functionality supported?
Hi, Yes, you can do that. In the provided example, the timer value can be modified using the cursor keys on the display. Regards,

A new question from [user_name] has been moved to a separate thread. The subject is: When trying to set a timer from a counter in [product_name] software and selecting [product_name] [version_no], the reference option for the timer is not available. Best regards, [user_name]

analysis.insight_summary: Users have confirmed that it is possible to adjust parameters like set values or timer durations directly through the TD display using arrow keys. This feature enhances remote management and usability, and matches expectations for manual control via the product's interface.
analysis.user_expectations: Users expect to easily and directly change set values such as temperature at any time, using the TD display arrow keys on the device.
